daemon.description: DaemonCommands is set but not commented out, but the template itself does not enable daemon mode — only provides default command-line arguments for daemon mode; actual daemon mode is controlled via the -D flag, which is not set by default

pidfile.description: Standard default; not overridden in the shipped config

verbose.description: Not controlled by any config line; depends on CLI -v flag; config has no equivalent

interval.description: Default; Interval line is commented out

format.description: Default; format is not controlled by config file — it's CLI only (e.g., -f for raw, -F for ascii), so the shipped config doesn't set it; default is 'ascii' per collectl docs

dir.description: Used in DaemonCommands as the -f path; this is the shipped default directory

compress.description: Not configurable in shipped config — controlled via CLI -Z/-z flags; default is compression enabled

retention.description: Encoded as -r00:00,7 in DaemonCommands — retention is 7 days

maxSize.description: Encoded as -F60 in DaemonCommands — 60 minutes between rotations. However, -F controls time-based rotation, not size. Size-based rotation is controlled via -m flag with -z for size limit. Since no size limit is specified in DaemonCommands, and shipped config has no maxSize setting, the *default* is 50000 KB per collectl docs. The shipped config doesn't override this, so default applies.

subsystems.description: List of subsystems to monitor (mapped from DaemonCommands '-s+YZ' + core subsystems)

custom_format.description: No custom format spec in shipped config

optional_features.description: From -s+YZ: 'y' enables infiniband, 'Z' enables zfs, and 'c' (process stats) may imply cgroup if enabled. Also, '-s cdm' implies procstat (c) and Y/Z imply their respective optional features.
